query:
SELECT 
  b.id,
  b.title,
  b.userId,
  b.createdAt,
  b.updatedAt,
  b.workflowStep,
  COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY b.title, b.userId) as duplicate_count
FROM books b
WHERE b.userId = (SELECT id FROM user WHERE email = 'paulinet77@gmail.com')
ORDER BY b.title, b.createdAt;
